dedupe_keys.name: xd twin now 6dplanner urban digital twin and project information model

description: xD Twin, renamed 6DPlanner in 2024, is a commercial web-based digital twin that brings the designs of buildings, roads, rails, tunnels, landscaping and utility networks into one project information model shown in 3D with CesiumJS. A 2022 Cesium article describes Helsinki examples with public transport, public spaces and air quality layers, going underground to inspect pipes and manholes, trees handled as BIM objects with species and growth information, and 4D scheduling that shows construction sequences and how the city changes over years. The 6DPlanner site now describes the tool as extending BIM with goals, scope, 3D solutions, 4D schedule, 5D quantities and costs and 6D life cycle impacts, with demos on request. Coverage: projects in Finland shown in the sources. Access: commercial; demos booked through the website. Licence: commercial. Caveats: no public pricing or data export details were found; the source describing the urban twin features is a 2022 vendor blog. Simulation uses are coordinating building, street and utility projects in a shared 3D twin and checking construction phasing in public space. Related records: Cesium and the Helsinki 3D city models.
